# Blur

Blurs the whole frame with a separable Gaussian, a box filter, or iterated Kawase passes, optionally at reduced resolution for wide, cheap blurs. Use opacity or a blend mode to soften rather than replace.

<EffectDemo effect="blur" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { blur } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/blur';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(blur({ preset: 'soft' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.mode = 'gaussian'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                            | Default      | Range     | Description                                                             |
| ------------ | ------------------------------- | ------------ | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`       | 'gaussian' \| 'box' \| 'kawase' | `'gaussian'` |           | Blur kernel.                                                            |
| `radius`     | number                          | `8`          | 0 – 96 px | Gaussian and box: blur radius in buffer pixels.                         |
| `iterations` | integer                         | `4`          | 1 – 8     | Kawase: number of passes; each widens the blur.                         |
| `resolution` | 'full' \| 'half' \| 'quarter'   | `'full'`     |           | Buffer size relative to the frame; lower is faster and widens the blur. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset   | Settings                                                |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `soft`   | `radius: 4`                                             |
| `heavy`  | `radius: 24`, `resolution: 'half'`                      |
| `kawase` | `mode: 'kawase'`, `iterations: 5`, `resolution: 'half'` |
| `box`    | `mode: 'box'`, `radius: 6`                              |

Apply one with `blur({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Blur & glow · tracked as story X5.1 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass. It also renders its own intermediate passes before the merged pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 5.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/blur`, including the shared effect runtime.
